p.body: A poisoned needle held at the neck during the Bene Gesserit test of humanity.

p.head: STONE BURNER
p.body: An atomic weapon whose light destroys the eyes of all who see it.

p.head: FREMEN LAW
p.body: The blind are given to the desert, to Shai-Hulud, the great worm.
